finding.claim: With default settings (allow_remote_refs=None), a $ref in an untrusted schema can make the tool read any local file outside the input directory. The only control is a deprecation warning. Verdict: PLAUSIBLE, by design and default-on, low severity. File contents leak only if they reach generated output, which is unverified. Parse-error messages reveal file existence and format regardless.
finding.source: A $ref string inside an attacker-supplied schema document (e.g. a schema from a third-party repo or URL processed in CI).
finding.sink: load_data_from_path(path, self.encoding) at parser/jsonschema.py:11005 reads and parses the resolved outside-base file.

containment check: is_relative_to(base_path) OR allow_remote_refs is True

finding.guards_checked: Base-path containment at 10978 is bypassed under the default. Deprecation warning only (10989). Explicit --no-allow-remote-refs blocks it (10992). Symlinks are resolved before the check. Not checked: whether file content is emitted into generated output.
